bible_refs.note: Abram named Abraham when the promises are given.

pass_a_gloss: That the perfect, having become another than what he was, then receives promises and blessing from God, let us consider. Abram does not receive the promises but Abraham, and Jacob does not receive the blessings but Israel; and Simon does not become first disciple of the Savior but Peter, and James and John are sent apostles having become Boanerges, that is sons of thunder.
pass_b_english: That the perfect, having become another than what he was, then receives promises and blessing from God, let us consider. Abram does not receive the promises, but Abraham does. Jacob does not receive the blessings, but Israel does. And Simon does not become the first disciple of the Savior, but Peter does. James and John are sent as apostles when they have become Boanerges, that is, sons of thunder (Genesis 17:5) (Genesis 32:28) (Matthew 16:17–18) (Mark 3:17).
